title: Left Main Landing Gear & Bay Doors
summary: Retractable heavy-duty left main landing gear strut, wheel/brake assembly, and serrated low-observable bay doors.
role: Absorbs landing impact loads and supports main fuselage weight on the ground before retracting flush into the center fuselage.
materials: High-strength aerospace steel/titanium strut with carbon brakes.
